files.name: Advancement Plaques
files.notes: Client-only advancement toast visuals. Needs Iceberg. CC BY-NC-ND.

files.name: BadOptimizations
files.notes: Client-only perf.

files.name: BetterF1
files.notes: ODD: jar named +1.21.7 but depends minecraft ~1.21 (any 1.21.x). Built against a newer MC; client mixin may not apply cleanly on 1.21.1. No source/contact in metadata.

files.name: BetterF3
files.notes: Client-only debug HUD.

files.name: Better Third Person
files.notes: Client-only camera. ARR.

files.name: Carved Wood
files.notes: 325 blockstates of decorative wood blocks; if used in the handcrafted map it must stay. Bundles cardinal-components. Contact points at fabric-example-mod template (no real source URL).

files.name: CobbleDollars
files.notes: Currency + merchant NPCs (villager template pools). cobblemon >=1.6.0+1.21.1 (no upper bound). 55 classes reference Cobblemon API. ARR.

files.name: CobbleFurnies
files.notes: 372 blockstates of Pokemon-themed furniture (labs, Pokecenters). Hard-required by LegendaryMonuments. cobblemon >=1.7.1, athena >=4.0.2, architectury >=13.0.8. 8 classes touch Cobblemon API.

files.name: Cobblemon
files.notes: Core mod 1.7.3+1.21.1. Target per task premise is 1.8.x. Bundles fabric-language-kotlin nested. Requires fabricloader >=0.17.2, fabric-api >=0.116.6+1.21.1, Java 21.

files.name: COBBLEVERSE Badges
files.notes: Gym badges/trophies items (Kanto-Sinnoh) - progression items. No cobblemon dependency declared, 0 API refs (pure items). Pack-specific Lumyverse mod, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (no-derivatives; distribution outside the pack is license-sensitive). Once given to players they persist in inventories.

files.name: Cobbreeding
files.notes: Breeding via pasture. cobblemon >=1.7.0 (no upper bound). Overrides cobblemon pasture blockstate. architectury 13.x, cloth-config >=15. 40 API refs - high coupling.

files.name: Controlling
files.notes: Client-only keybind search. Needs Searchables.

files.name: Debugify
files.notes: Vanilla bug fixes; env=* (has server-side fixes).

files.name: Euphoria Patcher
files.notes: Client-only; patches Complementary shaders (shaderpacks/ComplementaryUnbound_r5.8.1).

files.name: Forge Config API Port
files.notes: Needed by: sophisticatedcore (>=21.1.3), rctmod (>=21.1.1), particular (Reforged).

files.name: Iceberg
files.notes: Needed by: advancementplaques. CC BY-NC-ND.

files.name: ImmediatelyFast
files.notes: Client-only render perf. minecraft >=1.21 <=1.21.1.

files.name: Iron Chests
files.notes: Storage blocks players keep items in (10 blockstates). Bundles libgui.

files.name: Legendary Monuments
files.notes: Worldgen structures + 48 blockstates (shrines, Giratina island, etc.) for legendary encounters. version='Cobbleverse' = pack-custom build; no public source (template contact). Hard-depends cobblefurnies * and cobblemon >=1.7.0. 6 API refs.

files.name: Cozy Home
files.notes: 278 blockstates furniture. Template contact (no real source).

files.name: LumyMon
files.notes: Pack-specific Lumyverse mod: worldgen + structures + 64 blockstates + custom mechanics (17 API refs). cobblemon >=1.7.1 (no upper). Bundles fabric-permissions-api. CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 - license-sensitive to carry forward. Also GAMEPLAY-relevant.

files.name: LumyREI
files.notes: Client-only REI recipe integration (cooking pot/brewing/stark forge). cobblemon >=1.7.1. GPL-3.0.

files.name: MobsBeGone
files.notes: Server-side entity spawn blacklist; config/mobsbegone-blacklist.json lists most vanilla mobs (allay..giant..) - defines the campaign's mob roster. Keep mod + config together. ARR/Custom, modpack permission on file.

files.name: MoreCobblemonTweaks
files.notes: Cobblemon client QoL (PC multiselect, egg lore). cobblemon >=1.7.0, architectury >=13.0.8. 30 API refs (UI-level coupling - likely to break on UI changes). GPL-3.0.

files.name: Mouse Tweaks
files.notes: Client-only.

files.name: No Chat Restrictions
files.notes: ODD: built for MC 1.21.11 (depends >=1.21 <=1.21.11 so it will load on 1.21.1). Mixins were compiled against 1.21.11 - verify they apply. Purpose: removes chat signing restrictions.

files.name: Only Bottle Caps
files.notes: Bottle cap items (IV training). cobblemon >=1.7.0. No fabricloader dep declared. Bundles supermartijn642configlib.

files.name: Ping Wheel
files.notes: Location pings; needs server side too (env=*).

files.name: Platform
files.notes: Needed by: vanillabackport (>=1.3.3). Contains worldgen helper classes.

files.name: Resource Pack Overrides
files.notes: Client-only; forces pack resource packs active (config/resourcepackoverrides.json).

files.name: Roughly Enough Items
files.notes: Recipe viewer. env=* (server side for recipe sync). Bundles error_notifier.

files.name: Safe Pastures
files.notes: Pasture protection. cobblemon >=1.7.0. 1 API ref (low coupling).

files.name: ScalableLux
files.notes: Light engine rewrite (provides starlight). Server+client perf.

files.name: Searchables
files.notes: Needed by: controlling. Client-only.

files.name: StackDeobfuscator
files.notes: Deobfuscates stack traces in logs; useful while debugging the 1.8 migration, not needed by players.

files.name: VanillaBackport
files.notes: Backports newer vanilla content: 72 blockstates + worldgen/biomes/structures (terrablender entrypoint). Anything built with these blocks persists. Needs Platform. ARR. Bundles mixinsquared.

files.name: Accessories
files.notes: Needed by: mega_showdown (>=beta.52), zamega, accessories_compat_layer. Needs owo. Beta build.

files.name: Accessories Compatibility Layer
files.notes: Bridges Trinkets/Curios APIs onto Accessories (provides tclayer/cclayer). Needed only if any mod uses Trinkets API; nothing in this pack hard-depends on trinkets.

files.name: AdvancementDisable
files.notes: Disables mod advancements. Check config/advancementdisable.toml.

files.name: Architectury
files.notes: Needed by: cobblefurnies, cobbreeding, more_cobblemon_tweaks, fightorflight, mega_showdown, rctapi, zamega, brb. Version 13.0.8 is exactly the minimum several mods require.

files.name: Athena
files.notes: Needed by: cobblefurnies (>=4.0.2). Client entrypoint only.

files.name: Balm
files.notes: Needed by: waystones, defaultoptions, forgivingvoid, netherportalfix. Bundles kuma_api.

files.name: Beautify
files.notes: 57 decorative blockstates (blinds, trellis, frames). Needs cloth-config.

files.name: Better Pokédex Scanner
files.notes: HARD BLOCKER: depends cobblemon ">=1.7.3 <1.8.0" - loader will refuse to start with Cobblemon 1.8.x until a new build exists. Also needs fabric-language-kotlin >=1.13.6. Small QoL (aspect detection in scanner) - candidate for REMOVE if no 1.8 build.

files.name: Better Beds
files.notes: Client-only bed renderer.

files.name: Biome Replacer
files.notes: Replaces biomes at generation (config/biome_replacer.properties). Changing/removing it changes terrain of newly generated chunks - must be frozen for the map. minecraft >=1.19.4 <1.21.2.

files.name: Better Recipe Book
files.notes: Client-only recipe book tweaks. Needs architectury >=11.

files.name: Concurrent Chunk Management Engine
files.notes: Chunk perf (alpha). 28 nested jars. Requires fabricloader >=0.18.3. Touches worldgen threading - verify chunk output identical before generating the map.

files.name: Cobblemon Capture XP
files.notes: HARD BLOCKER: depends cobblemon "1.7.3+1.21.1" (exact pin; Fabric treats a bare version as equality) and tim_core >=1.7.3-fabric-1.31.0. Will not load with 1.8.x without a new build.

files.name: Catch Indicator
files.notes: Client-only Pokedex status indicator. Does NOT declare a cobblemon dependency but 13 classes reference com.cobblemon API (incl. Alphas/SizeVariation compat) - silent runtime breakage risk. ARR + permission.

files.name: Cobblemon Catch Rate Display
files.notes: Client-only catch-rate HUD. cobblemon >=1.6.0, breaks <1.6.0. 19 API refs.

files.name: Cloth Config v15
files.notes: Needed by: cobbreeding, fightorflight, beautify, moreculling, musicnotification, nethermap, paginatedadvancements, soundsbegone, toms_storage, brb, betterf3 (several also bundle it nested).

files.name: CobbleCuisine
files.notes: Food/snack items + bean crop block. cobblemon >=1.7.0. 22 API refs. Jar name says '1.7.rc1' (built for Cobblemon 1.7).

files.name: Cobblemon Additions
files.notes: Pokemon-themed villages/structures (datapack-turned-mod), spawn pools. No cobblemon dependency declared but ships assets/cobblemon + spawn_pool data and 2 API refs. Worldgen: villages will be in the map. CC0.

files.name: Cobblemon Battle Extras
files.notes: Battle UI/QoL + controller support. cobblemon >=1.6. 74 API refs (battle UI coupling - high break risk). Breaks cobblemon-ui-tweaks/cobblestats/move_inspector. ARR, permission on file.

files.name: Cobblemon Battle Positions
files.notes: Arena marker blocks (5 blockstates) placed in world for NPC/PVP battle positions - blocks persist in map. cobblemon >=1.7.0, rctapi >=0.14.0. Jar says 1.1.3, metadata version 1.1.2.

files.name: Cobblemon Raid Dens
files.notes: Raid dens: worldgen structures + raid crystal/home blocks (world-persistent). cobblemon >=1.7.0, geckolib >=4.7.0. 169 API refs (very high coupling). Suggests mega_showdown/cobbledollars/rctapi.

files.name: Cobblenav
files.notes: PokeNav item (spawn info/trainer contacts). cobblemon >=1.7.0. 191 API refs (very high coupling). MPL-2.0.

files.name: Comforts
files.notes: Sleeping bags/hammocks - placeable blocks (34 blockstates). Bundles spectrelib + cardinal-components.

files.name: Configurable
files.notes: Needed by: neruina (~3.5.2).

files.name: Continuity
files.notes: Client-only connected textures.

files.name: Custom Splash Screen
files.notes: Client-only; no minecraft dep declared. Needs midnightlib.

files.name: Entity Texture Features
files.notes: Client-only; minecraft '*'.

files.notes: Client perf (env=* but client entrypoint only). tr7zw protective license.

files.notes: Memory perf, server+client.

files.notes: Wild Pokemon attack/flee behaviour. cobblemon >=1.7.2, architectury, cloth-config. 83 API refs (high coupling).

Without it the COBBLEVERSE-DP-v31 / Loot / RCT datapacks are not applied. ARR. Metadata description is the template placeholder.

files.notes: Client-only; no minecraft dep declared.

files.notes: Item throw/pickup animations (env=*). Needs owo. Bundles owo-sentinel.

files.notes: Needed by: fancymenu (>=1.9.4).

files.notes: Network perf, server+client.

files.name: LibJF
files.notes: Needed by: respackopts (libjf-base/config-core-v2/data-manipulation). 12 nested modules.

files.name: Lithium
files.notes: Server+client perf.

files.notes: Mega Evolution/Z-moves/Tera/Dynamax + 34 blockstates (keystone ore, meteorite - world-persistent) + worldgen + 28 species files. cobblemon >=1.7.0, accessories >=beta.52, architectury. 163 API refs. NOTE: '1.8.4' is MSD's own version, NOT Cobblemon 1.8. Jar name pins '+1.7.3'. Custom MSD license.

files.name: Melody
files.notes: Needed by: fancymenu (>=1.0.6). Audio lib.

files.notes: Needed by: repurposed_structures (>=1.5.7), customsplashscreen (also nested there).

files.notes: 178 concrete-variant blockstates. Template contact.

files.notes: Perf, server+client.

files.notes: Client-only.

files.notes: Client-only; sodium >=0.6.7 required by breaks rule. Needs cloth-config.

files.notes: Client-only; no fabricloader dep declared.

files.notes: Ticking-entity crash guard (server+client). Needs configurable ~3.5.2. Bundles github-api (auto-report).

files.notes: Maps in nether. Needs cloth-config2.

files.name: NetherPortalFix
files.notes: Server-side portal linking. Needs balm. ARR.

files.name: NotEnoughAnimations
files.notes: Client animations (env=*, client entrypoint). tr7zw protective license.

files.name: Not Enough Crashes
files.notes: Crash handling. Sodium breaks <4.4.8 (ok at 4.4.9).

files.notes: Needed by: accessories (>=0.12.15.1), accessories_compat_layer (>=0.12.15.4), interactic (>=0.11.3), particular 1.1.2 (disabled).

files.notes: Raises packet/NBT size limits - useful for large Cobblemon PC/NBT payloads on servers. minecraft >=1.20.5, fabricloader '*'.

files.notes: Client-only advancement screen. Needs cloth-config.

files.notes: Client-only particle perf. Needs fzzy_config, kotlin.

files.notes: Client-only weather particles (beta).

files.notes: Particular Reforged (multiloader fork) - ambience particles. Needs forgeconfigapiport. env=* (server presence needed?) - verify; recommends iris.

files.notes: Pasture loot drops (config/PastureLoot.json). cobblemon >=1.7.1+1.21.1. 1 API ref. Empty description; ARR.

files.name: PlayerXP
files.notes: Player XP from battles. cobblemon >=1.6.0. 1 API ref (low coupling). No fabricloader dep declared.

files.name: Pokeblocks
files.notes: 314 blockstates (Pokemon figurines, baskets, etc.) - decorative blocks in the map. No cobblemon dependency; needs geckolib >=4.7.3. CC-BY-NC-4.0.

files.name: Radical Cobblemon Trainers API
files.notes: Radical Cobblemon Trainers API - trainer/battle API. Needed by: rctmod (>=0.15.0-beta), cobblemonbattlepositions (>=0.14.0); suggested by raiddens. cobblemon >=1.7 (no upper). 56 API refs. Gameplay-critical library.

files.name: Radical Cobblemon Trainers
files.notes: 1500+ trainers spawning (Radical Red/Unbound/BDSP) + 3 blockstates. cobblemon >=1.7.0, rctapi, forgeconfigapiport >=21.1.1. Pack ships COBBLEVERSE-RCT-DP-v20 datapack + RCTmod RP for it. Bundles jgrapht.

files.name: Rechiseled
files.notes: 3628 blockstates of decorative block variants - by far the largest block set; any use in the map makes it mandatory. Needs supermartijn642corelib >=1.1.20 <1.2.0, configlib, fusion. ARR + modpack permission.

files.name: Reese's Sodium Options
files.notes: Client-only; sodium >=0.8.12 (exactly the shipped version).

files.notes: Resource pack option menus (.rpo files in resourcepacks/). Needs libjf. Conflicts with quilt_loader/connectormod.

files.notes: Client-only renderer. Provides 'indium'. Large breaks list (iris <1.8.13, moreculling <1.0.8, notenoughcrashes <4.4.8, iceberg <1.2.7 - all satisfied).

files.name: Sophisticated Backpacks
files.notes: Backpacks holding player items. Needs sophisticatedcore >=1.2.9.15 <1.22. GPL-3 unofficial Fabric port.

files.name: Sophisticated Core
files.notes: Needed by: sophisticatedbackpacks, sophisticatedstorage. Needs forgeconfigapiport >=21.1.3, team_reborn_energy (nested). Breaks jei <19.21. 12 nested porting_lib jars.

files.name: Sophisticated Storage
files.notes: Storage blocks with player items (49 blockstates). Needs sophisticatedcore.

files.name: Sound Physics Remastered
files.notes: Audio (env=*, client effect). Breaks voicechat <2.3.0.

files.name: SoundsBeGone
files.notes: Client-only sound muting. Bundles posthog analytics lib (privacy note).

files.name: SuperMartijn642's Config Lib
files.notes: Needed by: rechiseled (>=1.1.6), obc (>=1.1.8; also nested there). ARR.

files.name: SuperMartijn642's Core Lib
files.notes: Needed by: rechiseled (>=1.1.20 <1.2.0). minecraft >=1.21 <1.21.2. ARR.

files.name: Tim Core
files.notes: HARD BLOCKER: depends cobblemon "1.7.3+1.21.1" (exact pin). Needed by: capture_xp. 106 API refs. Both Tim mods must be rebuilt for 1.8 or removed together.

files.name: TM Craft
files.notes: HARD BLOCKER: depends cobblemon "1.7.3+1.21.1" (exact pin). TMs with crafting recipes + move tutor / breeder table blocks (world-persistent). 31 API refs. GPL-3.0.

files.name: Tom's Simple Storage Mod
files.notes: Storage network blocks holding items (16 blockstates). minecraft >=1.21 <1.21.2. Bundles cardinal-components + cloth-config.

files.name: ToolTip Fix
files.notes: Client-only; jar says 1.20 but declares no minecraft dep (loads anywhere). Tiny mixin - low risk.

files.name: Trinkets
files.notes: Nothing in the pack hard-depends on trinkets (only recommended by accessories_compat_layer). Candidate for removal unless a resource/data pack or server plugin uses Trinkets slots. minecraft '>1.18' (very loose).

files.name: VillagerConfig
files.notes: Villager trade customization (config/VillagerConfig/villagerconfig.json5). If the pack defines custom trades there, becomes gameplay-relevant. No minecraft dep declared. Bundles fiber.

files.name: Waystones
files.notes: Waystone blocks (45 blockstates) + worldgen placement; player-activated waystones are world state. Needs balm. fabricloader >=0.17.3. ARR.

files.name: Xaero's Minimap
files.notes: Minimap (env=*, has server entrypoint; safe on server). Bundles xaerolib. Breaks xaeroworldmap <1.44.0 (ok).

files.name: Xaero's World Map
files.notes: World map. minecraft >1.20.6 <1.21.2. Breaks xaerominimap <26.4.0 (ok).

files.name: YetAnotherConfigLib
files.notes: Needed by: zoomify (>=3.6.6); recommended by debugify. fabricloader >=0.17.0.

files.name: zamega
files.notes: Legends Z-A megas: pure data (species_additions, spawn pools, cobblemon assets) - 0 API refs, but hard-depends mega_showdown >=1.6.2+1.7+1.21.1, cobblemon >=1.7, accessories, architectury. Follows MSD's fate. Jar version '1.7.3' = Cobblemon target.

files.name: Fast Noise
files.notes: Worldgen noise optimization - if it changes noise output the map's future chunks differ; verify determinism vs vanilla before generating. Requires fabricloader >=0.18.4 (highest floor in pack). Breaks moonrise/noisium.

files.name: Zoomify
files.notes: Client-only zoom. Needs YACL, kotlin >=1.13.8. fabricloader >=0.18.0.
